firstMismatch.message: poly_obj reaches setworn with the old crystal plate still occupying the armor slot

summary: C transforms the worn crystal plate and removes it before restoring the replacement armor. JavaScript skips that armor removal in poly_obj, then setworn throws because the old item still occupies the slot.

source.branch: For an inventory object with old_wornmask, C computes the replacement slot, calls remove_worn_item(obj, TRUE), then assigns the replacement with setworn and calls set_wear before rereading the worn slot (zap.c:1929-1949). JavaScript excludes W_ARMOR from its removable branch, records the discarded call, and reaches setworn while the old armor remains in state.uarm.
callers: potion.c:potion_dip calls poly_obj for the selected polymorph dip target (potion.c:2442-2492); js/potion.js:potion_dip reaches js/zap.js:poly_obj.
dependencies: steal.c:remove_worn_item is an existing void helper; its armor arm calls Armor_off/Cloak_off/other slot callbacks before clearing residual worn bits (steal.c:213-290; js/steal.js:327-380).
do_wear.c:set_wear is an existing void helper; C runs it after restoring the replacement slot (do_wear.c:1539-1568; js/do_wear.js:2695-2727).

evidence: Admitted baseline-261c3097d-v55.json records the selected case at 0/236 screens, 0/2405 RNG calls, and 0/236 cursors, with runtime error 'worn requires cancelDoff for otyp 122'. The canonical queue identity has manifest digest 3c17045e325445fd449f429e13ff79d2eb858dc308a82f9e2a7c371ad9c56105, recording digest 54c23bf00954addc49c12419192ee2266f50e1972585dbd18b71b443e506a4d3, recipe digest bb9901d3e5dff5eaa8abedca802e216072c37a535dda52c8ec161c44a50d5a8b, and input digest 68f27e6ff0211427a9f14f32d5761378682c2c211faa48787b15551c7dfb6787.

Single-case diagnostic before the fix: run-mmk8Kk, replay commit 24eb26d1d8cfb2476d6e2fd15583798481ab7c55, stops in js/zap.js:poly_obj at await setworn(replacement, newWornMask, env), with stack through js/potion.js:potion_dip. Log: /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-mmk8Kk/stdout.log.

Source comparison: zap.c:poly_obj at 1929-1949 always calls remove_worn_item(obj, TRUE) before setworn; js/zap.js previously skipped that helper whenever oldWornMask included W_ARMOR. The exact helper already supports armor removal through Armor_off and source-owned slot clearing.
